correctness.rationale: Exact full-dimensional support formula is obtained by maximizing over the two disjoint families of stable-set indicator vertices. Each sign-block sum has verified mean μ(p−q), variance nσ², and cross-covariance −nμ². Joint multivariate CLT and a radial delta-method yield the independent centered Gaussian term and negatively correlated folded terms; block-sum/radial cross-covariances scale as (p−q)/n and vanish under finite-t assumptions. A bivariate Gaussian orthant calculation proves the arcsine antipodal probability; derivative and Chebyshev yield sharp transition and outer-scale limit. Cramér decomposition proves non-normality. Standalone file check.py verifies 864 finite support cases and seeded Monte Carlo diagnostics, which are not substituted for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The invariant directly measures angular overlap between opposite vertex normal fans, an intrinsic random linear-optimization question not captured by scalar mean width, f-vectors, or ellipsoids. The exact balanced value 0.3453556059… disproves the naive independent-level value 1/2, exposes a persistent negative covariance, and the complete joint limit identifies a natural √n imbalance crossover and a genuinely non-Gaussian fluctuation law across an infinite canonical polytope family.
